record.body:
## Problem

A change can alter behavior no claim asked for. The differential spike found the relaxation behind the forged close, but only with a hand-built generator for one pure function.

## Approach

not yet scoped — discuss when this phase is current. Direction: `aff audit` runs declared probes (a command or function plus inputs) at base and head and reports differences no claim accounts for, with a coarse CLI-level comparison as the default. A program flags each difference; only a cited claim id or a person settles it.

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase. At minimum: on the `red-first` range the audit reports the `revision`-on-`tdd` relaxation as a difference no claim covers, and a difference covered by a cited claim is not reported.
